name: How long does kitchen flooring installation usually take?

mainEntity.name: How long does kitchen flooring installation usually take?

acceptedAnswer.text: A typical kitchen flooring installation takes between one and four days of labor. The timeline depends heavily on the material selected, the room size, and subfloor prep. Floating luxury vinyl plank can often be completed in one to two days because it locks together without mortar. In contrast, porcelain or ceramic tile usually requires three to four days to allow for mortar setting, grouting, and sealing before regular foot traffic can resume. Additional time may be necessary if the existing subfloor needs leveling, moisture barrier installation, or tear-out of old, glued-down materials.
acceptedAnswer.description: Installation usually takes 1 to 4 days. Luxury vinyl plank often finishes in 1 to 2 days, while tile requires 3 to 4 days to allow mortar and grout to cure properly.
